question: What is the maximum Delcorn will pay per night for a hotel in London?
answer: £160 per night including breakfast (Head of function may approve up to £190 during major events)

question: What is the hotel cap outside London (e.g. Leeds or Manchester)?
What mileage rate does Delcorn pay for business journeys in your own car?
answer: 45p per mile for the first 10,000 business miles in a tax year, then 25p per mile

question: How long do staff have to submit an expense claim?
answer: 30 days from the date the expense was incurred, via Ledgerline Expenses (older than 30 days needs Finance Manager approval; over 90 days not paid)

question: What is the annual leave entitlement for a full-time employee?
answer: 27 days plus bank holidays, rising by 1 day for every 2 years' service to a maximum of 30 days, plus one wellbeing day

question: How much annual leave can be carried over and by when must it be used?
answer: Up to 5 days, to be taken by 31 March of the following year (more only with People Director approval in exceptional circumstances)

question: What Bradford factor score triggers a formal (Stage 1) absence review?
answer: 128 or more over a rolling 52 weeks (or 3 spells in 6 months); B = S² × D

question: What data must never be entered into AI tools at Delcorn?
answer: Passwords/MFA codes/API keys and bank or card details in any AI tool; safeguarding and Prevent case details outside the restricted library; and any learner personal data, special category data, staff HR data or employer commercially sensitive information in any tool other than Microsoft 365 Copilot

question: How long are learner records kept?
answer: 6 years after the end of the funding period (the learner's final funding claim), then securely deleted

question: Which location has the most Delcorn employees?
sql: SELECT location FROM employees GROUP BY location ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees are based in Delcorn's largest location?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY location ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most common IT service desk ticket category in the last 12 months?
sql: SELECT category FROM it_tickets WHERE opened >= date('2026-11-05','-12 months') GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many P1 (critical) IT tickets were raised in the last 12 months?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM it_tickets WHERE priority = 'P1' AND opened >= date('2026-11-05','-12 months')

question: How many 'Copilot access & licensing' tickets were raised in the last 12 months?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM it_tickets WHERE category = 'Copilot access & licensing' AND opened >= date('2026-11-05','-12 months')
